name: Sports
headline: A New List
Every Matchday.
statement: The Suite Stays. The Guest List Does Not.
short: Suites, sponsor hospitality and matchdays across a full season.
intro: Matchday hospitality repeats every week and changes every week. VOW keeps guest lists, suites and sponsor access organised across a whole season, and gives each guest a clear plan for the day.
imageAlt: A host serving guests in a stadium hospitality suite at night

points.title: Hospitality That Scales across a Season
points.text: Reuse groups and hosts from event to event while keeping each matchday’s list current.

points.title: Sponsors and Partners in View
points.text: Manage sponsors, speakers and VIP groups in the same place as your general guest list.

points.title: Digital Tickets and Access
points.text: Issue and update tickets and access passes in real time, right up to the gate.

line: Premium Hospitality. Partner Programs. Season Ticket Memberships. VIP Experiences.
description: Connecting premium hospitality, partnerships and season ticket membership programs with the teams, hosts, groups and guests behind them to elevate experiences, strengthen relationships and drive loyalty, retention and revenue.

name: Media & Entertainment
headline: Every Group,
a Different Night.
statement: One Building. A Different Plan for Every Group Inside It.
short: Award shows, premieres, upfronts and tours, with every list in sync.
intro: Premieres, award shows, upfronts and tours bring talent, press, sponsors and VIP guests into the same room, on lists that change by the hour. VOW keeps every group in one live view, each with the right schedule and access.
imageAlt: Guests watching an arena concert from a VIP platform

points.title: One List for Talent, Press and Partners
points.text: Manage guests, groups and hosts together, with RSVPs and registrations feeding the same live record.

points.title: A Personal Schedule for Each Guest
points.text: VOW GO puts each guest’s details, passes and updates in their pocket, on web or mobile.

points.title: Changes Reach Everyone at Once
points.text: Use the real-time communications hub and alerts to tell the right people the moment a schedule or arrival changes.

line: Award Shows. Premieres. Upfronts. Opening Nights. Live Productions. Tours.
description: Connecting guests, groups, hosts, sponsors and corporate partners with production, talent, publicity, press, handlers and security to orchestrate exceptional guest experiences across high-stakes, ever-changing environments, from red carpet moments to live productions.

name: Philanthropy & Nonprofits
headline: Known by Name
before They Arrive.
statement: From the Car Door to the Last Goodbye, Every Donor Is Expected.
short: Galas, auctions and donor events where every guest is known by name.
intro: A gala works when donors feel recognised. VOW helps your team know every guest, manage hosts and tables, and make arrival, seating and departure feel effortless.
imageAlt: A guest placing a card into an envelope on a candlelit gala table

points.title: Know Every Guest
points.text: Keep guest, group and host details together, from the first RSVP to the last goodbye.

points.title: Arrival, Check-In and Departure
points.text: Coordinate cars, doors and departures so every donor’s arrival feels expected.

points.title: Payments in the Same Experience
points.text: Take payments and handle purchases inside the guest experience, not in a separate system.

line: Galas. Benefits. Giving Programs. Donor Cultivation & Stewardship Events.
description: Connecting development and event teams, boards, committees and hosts with donors, sponsors, corporate partners, groups and guests to elevate fundraising experiences, deepen donor relationships and advance stewardship.

name: Corporate & Finance
headline: Every Relationship,
in View.
statement: Every Client Arrives to a Team That Already Knows the Plan.
line: Brand Experiences. Executive Hospitality. Investor Events. Private Client & Membership Experiences.
short: Brand experiences and executive hospitality for clients, investors and members.
intro: Brand experiences and executive hospitality involve several business units and many relationship owners. VOW keeps clients, investors, members and VIP guests in one live view, so every team knows who is coming and who is looking after them.
imageAlt: A group gathers outside a storefront with a gold ribbon stretched across the entrance

points.title: One View across Business Units
points.text: Manage guests, groups and hosts from every team in the same place.

points.title: Hosts Matched to Guests
points.text: Give each relationship owner the schedule and details of the people they are hosting.

points.title: Work with the Systems You Have
points.text: Connect work across the apps and legacy systems your teams already use.

description: Connecting event teams, business units, corporate partners and relationship owners with clients, investors, members and VIP guests across brand experiences and executive hospitality to strengthen business relationships and create opportunities for growth.

name: Olympics & Grand Scale
headline: Many Venues.
One Record.
statement: Weeks of Venues, and One Record That Keeps Up.
short: Delegations, partners and multi-venue programs across weeks.
intro: The Olympics and other large-scale programs bring delegations, families, partners and press together for weeks, across many venues. VOW puts the people running them on one real-time platform, keeping every group informed and every credential current.
imageAlt: A ceremonial flame above a packed stadium at night

points.title: Weeks-Long Programs, One Record
points.text: Keep schedules, groups and guests organised across every day of competition.

points.title: Real-Time Updates across Venues
points.text: Alerts and notifications reach the right people when plans shift, wherever they are.

points.title: Replace the Spreadsheet Stack
points.text: Streamline complex spreadsheets and connect work across the apps and legacy systems you already use.

line: Premium Hospitality. Multi-Wave Programs. Multi-Day & Multi-Venue Experiences. Corporate Partner & Delegation Programs.
description: Connecting sales, planning and operations teams, stakeholders and collaborators with groups, hosts and guests, alongside key platforms and hospitality partners, to orchestrate inventory, allocations, entitlements and benefits at immense scale.
